broader_browser_notes: Two image-loading failures were caused by the local API generating localhost:4370 asset URLs while the test site ran on 127.0.0.1:4380.

After correcting WRITE_WEB_URL, image upload passed. The combined cell/image test reached its existing image-toolbar assertion failure; the PDF thread-control assertion also failed in the broader run.
The image-toolbar and PDF-thread cases correspond to known baseline cases recorded in deploy/verification-clean-suggestions-20261025.json.
